sections.heading: Objective
sections.body: Enable customers to complete purchases securely and efficiently with minimal friction. Target checkout completion time: under 2 minutes.

subsections.title: FR-001: Cart Management
subsections.description: Users must be able to add, remove, and update items in their cart. Cart state must persist for 30 days for logged-in users.

subsections.title: FR-002: Inventory Reservation
subsections.description: When checkout is initiated, inventory must be reserved for 15 minutes to prevent overselling.

subsections.title: FR-003: Payment Processing
subsections.description: Support credit/debit card payments via Stripe. Must handle 3D Secure authentication.

subsections.title: FR-004: Order Confirmation
subsections.description: Send email confirmation within 5 seconds of successful payment. Include order details and estimated delivery.

subsections.title: FR-005: Guest Checkout
subsections.description: Allow users to checkout without creating an account. Capture email for order tracking.

subsections.title: NFR-001: Performance
subsections.description: Checkout initiation response time: < 500ms. Payment processing: < 3 seconds.

subsections.title: NFR-002: Availability
subsections.description: System must maintain 99.9% uptime during business hours.

subsections.title: NFR-003: Security
subsections.description: PCI-DSS Level 1 compliance. All payment data handled by Stripe (no storage).

subsections.title: NFR-004: Scalability
subsections.description: Support 1000 concurrent checkout sessions during peak hours.

sections.heading: Business Rules
items: Cart abandonment email sent after 24 hours
